hash(NbtMap) - Static method in class dev.opencollab.paletter.block.BlockHashes
The hashed network id of a block state, as the client computes it: FNV-1a 32 bit over the little endian (not network / varint) NBT of the compound {name, states}, with an empty root name, the state values sorted by key, and no version tag.

PaletteException - Exception Class in dev.opencollab.paletter
Thrown when a palette cannot be compiled: content of a layer that cannot be (a duplicate identifier, a block network id hash collision, a callback that throws), or data of the data source that cannot be (no vanilla voxel shapes for a version).

PaletteLayer.Builder - Class in dev.opencollab.paletter

Paletter - Class in dev.opencollab.paletter

Paletter.Builder - Class in dev.opencollab.paletter
